verdict.rationale: The Composio CLI documents authentication (`composio login --agent`) and installing agent plugins into Codex/Claude Code (`composio setup --target auto`), covering the auth and install-into-agents ends of the workflow. But building/staging and pushing an actual MCP server is only shown via the Python SDK (`composio.mcp.create(...)`), not via any CLI subcommand — the CLI docs describe connecting apps, executing tools, inspecting schemas and debugging, not building or deploying servers. Missing for 10: CLI commands for staging/building an MCP server, CLI push/deploy command, and any hands-on confirmation of a full CLI-driven publish pipeline.
